proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL nakha subsection 1 explicitly gives nasal early variants such as Domaaki naṅ and Phalura nāṅg/nōṅg, eastern Nepali naṅ, and Punjabi nahũ/Maithili nauh/Bhojpuri nõh. Buksa nũɡ and Dang nuhũ nail fit this regional nasal family with source vowels, final g and aspiration preserved. Local transmission and the precise nasal development are qualified rather than assigned a new intermediate reconstruction. Exact response: nuhũ.
